objective: Convert the BENCHPROD-052 production medium repeat baseline into an executable benchmark gate with pass/fail reports.

tasks.title: Benchmark gate evaluator
expected_changes: Add bench_gate.py to evaluate repeat and matrix benchmark artifacts against production gate thresholds.
Use BENCHPROD-052 production medium repeat as the default threshold baseline.
Support allowlisted unstable suites/cases so known variance is explicit.
Emit machine-readable and Markdown gate reports.
Document gate commands in FusionDB-bench README.
Verify baseline pass, expected failure, and tiny smoke pass scenarios.

verification_results.command: python -m py_compile bench_gate.py bench_repeat.py bench_stability.py bench_trend.py fusiondb_matrix.py fusiondb_bench.py
